page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8i.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 5.33 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning training. However, it provides a high-capacity network interface with a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer for distributed environments.

Given its massive dedicated core count and high memory capacity, the ecs.ebmg8i.48xlarge offers high resource density for enterprise-scale workloads. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a design tradeoff that optimizes cost efficiency for compute-heavy and memory-intensive tasks that rely on external storage arrays. It is suited for large-scale web serving, enterprise databases, high-performance computing simulations, and heavy container orchestration.
